artworks.title: The Judgment of Paris
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with mythical elements. Four nude figures are standing around an armored fallen figure in a wooded landscape. Above them, a chariot is flying through the sky, drawn by animals and surrounded by beams of light. A castle is visible in the background. The drawing is intricately detailed and features a dramatic composition with classical motifs and symbols. The combination of earthly and ethereal elements creates a sense of drama and mystery.

artworks.title: Oblong Ornament Panel
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.1 x 1.8 cm (2 3/8 x 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a vertical rectangle filled with swirling lines and circular shapes, forming an abstract design. Within the composition are elements resembling leaves or flower petals encased in circular frames. One section contains a form reminiscent of a blooming flower. At the bottom, a shape evokes a seashell or horn, from which curved lines extend, adding a sense of organic growth to the design.

artworks.title: Erato
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing with one leg raised and leaning slightly forward. They are holding a circular object in their hands and appear focused. The person has long hair and is wearing a flowing garment. They are barefoot, and there is another similar object near their feet. The background shows hills and sparse vegetation.

artworks.title: The Judgment of Paris
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting fantastical elements including figures with helmets and armor, a tree, and cloud shapes. The drawing shows three intricate figures on the left with one holding a shield, positioned near a detailed tree and a cloud-like form above. To the right is a complex structure with a winged figure perched on top of the tree. In the lower area, a reclined figure wearing decorative armor is surrounded by smaller, humanoid forms. The detailed linework and shading create a textured and elaborate quality. The imagery suggests an inspiration from classical mythology or an allegorical theme.

artworks.title: Capricci di varie battaglie (Frontispiece)
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man with a mustache and wavy hair, wearing an elaborate outfit. Surrounding the man is an oval frame with decorative elements and four cherubic figures engaged in various activities. Below the portrait is a banner with an inscription and the year "1637." The background is filled with intricate line work.

artworks.title: Capricci di varie battaglie (Title Page)
artworks.description: This is an image of a battle-themed scene with a banner inscribed "CAPRICCI DI VARIE BATTAGLIE di Gio Guglielmo Baur 1635." The drawing shows a mounted figure on horseback blowing a trumpet with a flag, alongside war implements like cannons and cannonballs in the foreground. Other figures in the background are raising flags and possibly preparing for battle. The image features strong lines, detailed shading, and a central focus on the large banner.

artworks.title: Capricci di varie battaglie
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene on horseback. The image shows mounted soldiers engaged in combat, wielding weapons such as spears, swords, and bows. The horses and riders are shown in various poses, giving a sense of movement and chaos. The background is lightly sketched, suggesting an open terrain setting, with detailed and intricately drawn figures capturing the motion and action of the scene.

artworks.title: Capricci di varie battaglie
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene. Mounted soldiers are engaged in combat, depicted in energetic lines. The movement of the horses and gestures of the figures suggest high tension and action. Smoke in the background indicates gunfire, adding to the sense of turmoil. The scene is detailed, with each figure and animal carefully rendered, enhancing the drama and intensity of the composition.

artworks.title: Capricci di varie battaglie
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battlefield scene. The drawing depicts a battlefield with numerous figures engaged in combat, some on horseback and others on foot. In the foreground, a figure stands with their back to the viewer, holding a large flag with a leaping feline figure holding an object. Surrounding this figure are other figures observing the battle below. Smoke and tumultuous activity dominate the background, suggesting chaos and movement. The sky is filled with dynamic clouds, enhancing the scene below. The style of the drawing reflects a classic etching or pen-on-paper representation common in historical depictions of war scenes.

artworks.title: Capricci di varie battaglie
artworks.description: The image shows horses running down a hill. The drawing features strong, fluid lines capturing the horses' form. The background includes clouds in a slightly turbulent sky, adding to the energy of the scene. The composition suggests rapid movement and urgency, with the horses positioned to convey depth and motion.

artworks.title: Capricci di varie battaglie
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a naval battle scene. Figures in small boats are engaged in combat, wielding weapons amidst water and smoke. The boats are filled with individuals in a struggle on turbulent waters. The scene conveys movement and tension through dynamic poses of the figures and swirling lines of smoke. Two heads can be seen in the water below. The drawing uses strong lines for texture and detail, capturing the intensity of the event.

artworks.title: Capricci di varie battaglie
artworks.description: The image shows a battle scene with mounted soldiers engaged in combat. The drawing features soldiers on horseback fighting with swords and spears, with detailed depictions of the chaotic scene. The horses are shown in motion, some rearing and others falling. In the background, a large group of soldiers is visible, contributing to the overall sense of scale and excitement in the battlefield.

artworks.title: Capricci di varie battaglie
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene with soldiers on horseback. The drawing depicts soldiers engaging in combat atop rearing horses. The line work captures the motion of the battle, with smoke billowing in the background. Horses appear to be maneuvering and soldiers are depicted in various poses.

artworks.title: Capricci di varie battaglie
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene with a rider on a rearing horse. The horse is depicted energetically rearing up amidst a tumultuous battle. The rider is wearing an elaborate costume with a feathered hat and a billowing cloak. Figures on foot are engaged in military action with some holding rifles. The background shows a dynamic sky with swirling clouds and flying birds, adding to the intensity of the scene. The composition is detailed and dynamic, capturing the motion and tension of the moment.

artworks.title: Capricci di varie battaglie
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene with mounted warriors. The central figure is on horseback, charging forward with a raised spear. Other figures on horseback and on foot surround the central figure, suggesting a melee. The background shows an expansive battlefield with many figures, indicating a large-scale confrontation. The clouds in the sky are rendered with light strokes.

artworks.title: Capricci di varie battaglie
artworks.description: This is a drawing of ships and soldiers in a harbor. The scene depicts soldiers boarding a small boat, with a large ship visible in the background and additional structures along the shore. The figures in the boat are armed and dressed in historical military attire. The composition is detailed, showcasing the rigging and decking of the ship, as well as textures of fabrics and wooden surfaces. The sky is illustrated with thinly etched clouds. The drawing captures a moment in maritime history, possibly depicting troops' embarkation or disembarkation.

artworks.title: Capricci di varie battaglie
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene involving mounted soldiers. The image captures soldiers on horseback engaged in a skirmish. The central focus is on two horses rearing against each other. Weaponry such as swords and scimitars are raised and in use. The contours and shading enhance the musculature of the horses and details of the armor and attire, with intricate line work. The surrounding area appears cluttered with fallen figures and weapons.

artworks.title: Capricci di varie battaglie
artworks.description: This drawing shows a battle scene with cannons and soldiers. It features mounted and foot soldiers among several large, wheeled cannons. A rider on horseback surveys the scene, looking back at the line of artillery. The cannons are lined up in a row, with cannonballs scattered on the ground nearby. Soldiers stand behind the cannons holding spears and banners. Smoke fills the air, possibly from cannon fire or burning. The scene is highly detailed, with intricate line work capturing the texture of the uniforms, horses, and machinery.

artworks.title: Five Cupids Playing
artworks.description: This is a drawing of winged figures interacting with animals and each other. The image depicts winged, cherub-like figures engaged in various activities. One figure is riding a goat and holding its horns for balance, while another figure stands nearby, guiding the goat with a rope. In the foreground, a figure is kneeling and holding a stick while interacting with another figure seated on a platform. The seated figure appears to be holding an object resembling a dagger. The background has a textured pattern that may represent grass.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child at a Fountain
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within image at top and sides): 16.6 × 13.6 cm (6 9/16 × 5 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman sitting with a child on her lap. The woman has a gentle expression and long hair, wearing a flowing robe. The child is facing her, reaching up with one hand. In the background are trees, hills, a building, and a fountain with a lion's head spouting water into a basin. The illustration is detailed, capturing textures and elements in the scene.

artworks.title: Veronica
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright in the center, holding a cloth with an image of a face at its center. The person has delicate features, a calm expression, and a halo. They wear a headdress or cloak covering their hair and a flowing robe. The cloth displays a face with curly hair and a crown of thorns. The background features architectural elements with decorated arches and a patterned design.

artworks.title: The Flute Player
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures, a man and a woman, seated beside each other within a circular frame. The woman's body is shown from the knees up and the man is shown from the waist up, leaning slightly forward. The woman has delicate facial features with a serene expression, and her hair is styled under a headdress. She is dressed in ornate clothing with elaborate patterns and a high collar, while the man wears a wide-brimmed hat and a fur-trimmed cloak over his shoulders. He holds a long staff or rod in his right hand and appears to have a short beard. The background features intricate designs resembling foliage and animals.

artworks.title: Veronica
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body view of a figure standing and facing forward. She is dressed in flowing garments with a headscarf covering her hair and framing her face. Her facial features are serene with large eyes and a straight nose. The woman holds a cloth with both hands, which displays an image of a man's face with closed eyes, long hair, and a beard. The background features an architectural setting with decorative columns and arches adorned with leaves and ribbons. The scene is depicted in a detailed woodcut or engraving style characterized by strong black lines and intricate detailing.

artworks.title: Emperor Charles V
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 20.9 x 13.8 cm (8 1/4 x 5 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in a profile view, facing to the right. He has a moustache and beard and short, curly hair partly covered by a flat cap. The man wears regal attire with ornate embroidery and a necklace with a medallion. The background has textured etched lines. Below the image, there is engraved text within a decorative border.
